about: Nodes whose code is merged into packages/tex/gateway/agent/graph/gatewayNodes.js but not wired into texConfig.json yet (Dev2, 2026-11-16: "for code changes, create the node inside the code first and merge it to main"). A shelf node never runs: the runner runs only the config's nodes. A Lab draft wires it, and Promote takes it off the shelf in the same pull request that puts it in the config. Each entry: the node's id, its files (repository paths), and what it is for.

connect.why: Connect the notes a turn wrote (Dev2, 2026-11-20: "it can't make connections to notes beyond names"; chose "score, then finder + connect step"). After a turn that wrote notes (turn steps carry `wrote`), a model reads each note and the finder's notes beside it with read-only tools and names the few that share something real; code writes each link both ways as `- [[Other]]: why` under ## Connections and touches no other line. Unwired, nothing changes: a Lab draft wires send -> connect (background, when fired) with input { notes, question, tainted }.

examples.why: The Training moments nearest to the text the front door is answering (Dev2, 2026-11-18: the front door's examples are picked for this text, not fixed). The front door starts it at its first step with the text and its recent lines; it embeds them with the meaning-search model and reads the nearest of the Training moments from the Tex-owned index, dropping the scored conversation, and the front door reads them in its preamble after a budget (ms, default 100). Without the index, a model, or an answer in time, the front door keeps its fixed examples. Unwired, nothing changes: a Lab draft turns it on with fd -> examples (uses).
